impact: The neocloud and chip rally lifts NBIS into its Thursday premarket report and supports MU and DRAM; with bonds shut, Thursday's yield move and Friday's PPI could quickly test the rebound.
summary: The Nasdaq Composite closed up about 1.6% at 25,466.19, the S&P 500 up about 1.3% at 7,619.38 and the Dow up about 0.5% at 52,486.49 on Wednesday. CoreWeave surged about 24% after its Q3 beat and raised outlook, Nvidia gained about 4% despite a Baird downgrade to Neutral, and the VanEck Semiconductor ETF jumped about 6%. The Nasdaq erased its post-election losses; bonds were closed for Veterans Day.
title: Nasdaq closes +1.6%, S&P +1.3% as CoreWeave's 24% jump revives AI trade
